title: R&D bi-weekly meeting agenda
description: The R&D bi-weekly agenda from one meeting to the next (process map 'R&D bi-weekly agenda preparation', step 8 of 8, 20 Oct 2026): open projects and their status, what changed since the last meeting, blockers, decisions needed and owners, every line cited to the record it came from. The cycle starts at the previous agenda's posting in the meeting chat (stage 1, 'start from last cycle's agenda'). Sources the map names that the ontology does not hold (the R&D KB Board, Portal R&D projects, samples, sourcing requests, stability, FileMaker formulas) are named gaps on every answer, never silent. The Teams lanes read the projected Teams messages (ontology/schema/generated/graph_teams.json); message text is cited, and becomes a line's title only once a projection declares a body property (text_expected).
